text: The normal X-ray rules out a fracture from your previous fall, which is good news. Given your symptoms of pain at the base of the thumb that worsens with lifting your infant, I suspect De Quervain's tenosynovitis. To confirm this, do you feel a sharp pain or a catching sensation when you make a fist with your thumb inside and then bend your wrist toward your pinky finger (Finkelstein's test)?
